descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: Use for tasks to look at, examine, or inspect an object under a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. 'look at the alarmclock under the desklamp').
descriptions.pick_and_place: Use for plain single-object moves: 'put/move/place a X in/on Y' with no heating, cooling, or cleaning and only one object.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Use when the task says to clean, wash, or put a clean/wet/dirty object somewhere (e.g. 'put a clean plate in the cabinet'). Cleans at the sinkbasin.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Use when the task says to cool, chill, refrigerate, or put a cold/cooled object somewhere (e.g. 'put a cold apple on the table'). Cools in the fridge.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Use when the task says to heat, warm, cook, or put a hot/heated object somewhere (e.g. 'put a hot potato on the countertop'). Heats in the microwave.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Use when the task asks to put two of an object kind (e.g. 'two pillows', 'two cds') in or on a destination; carries one at a time.
